sections.value: THIS DEED OF CONVEYANCE is made on the {{date}}.
{{partyOne.name}}, a {{partyOne.occupation}} of {{partyOne.address}} (VENDOR) of the ONE PART
{{partyTwo.name}}, a {{partyTwo.occupation}} of {{partyTwo.address}} (PURCHASER) of the OTHER PART.

value:
1. {{sourceOfTitle}}.

2. The VENDOR is the beneficial owner in possession of the whole piece or parcel of land described in the schedule to this deed.

3. The VENDOR having acquired interest over the said parcel of land is now desirous of alienating his entire interest in the said property to the PURCHASER for valuable consideration.

4. The VENDOR having a valid title and being in possession free from encumbrances has agreed with the PURCHASER to alienate and transfer all his rights and interest in and over ALL THAT piece or parcel of land described in the schedule hereto.

5. The parties hereto have agreed to enter into these presents with the intent that same be used in support of an application for a Statutory Certificate of Occupancy to the Governor of {{state}}.

IN PURSUANCE of the said understanding and in consideration of the sum of {{amount}} now paid by the PURCHASER to the VENDOR (the receipt of which the VENDOR hereby acknowledges); the VENDOR conveys unto the PURCHASER ALL that piece or parcel of land, measuring approximately {{propertyDescription}} which property is particularly described in the schedule to this Deed, the same is delineated and coloured Red on the survey plan No. {{surveyPlanNumber}} annexed to this Deed, TO HOLD the same unto the purchaser absolutely, free from all encumbrances however called without any right of reversion.

sections.value: ALL THAT piece or parcel of land with all the appurtenances thereto commonly known as and locally called {{propertyAddress}}, measuring approximately {{propertyDescription}} which piece or parcel of land is more particularly described, delineated and verged red in survey Plan No. {{surveyPlanDetails}} drawn by one Surveyor {{surveyorParticulars}} on the Survey Plan.
IN WITNESS OF WHICH the parties have execute this deed in the manner below the day and year first above written.
